subject.title: fix: beta releases require manual reruns after plugin publication

question: Should beta releases be allowed to publish core as `beta-live` before plugin npm, ClawHub convergence, and packaged-upgrade evidence complete, with the continuation workflow owning later ecosystem repair?
rationale: This is an intentional release-completion policy change rather than a purely mechanical bug fix; code review cannot determine the acceptable operational tradeoff between beta speed and deferred ecosystem convergence.

options.title: Approve beta-live policy after coverage repair
options.body: Keep stable and explicit-wait releases blocking, retain the missing cron coverage IDs, and accept the documented asynchronous repair model for ordinary betas.

options.title: Keep all beta ecosystem checks blocking
options.body: Retain the existing completion semantics and use the new readiness tooling only for parallel diagnostics and faster retries.

options.title: Limit the policy to a documented trial
options.body: Gate the nonblocking path behind an explicit release-owner choice until it has been exercised across multiple beta cycles.

recommendation.title: Approve beta-live policy after coverage repair
recommendation.body: Keep stable and explicit-wait releases blocking, retain the missing cron coverage IDs, and accept the documented asynchronous repair model for ordinary betas.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows the strongest direct connection to the release orchestration and continuation design.
